mechanical_qa.parsed_title: Recurrent Guillain-Barré Syndrome – Case Series — Summary, Evaluation, and Appraisal

semantic_spot_checks.finding: 13 of 404 patients (3.2%) met recurrent GBS criteria after exclusions; 23.1% changed GBS variant; disability scores were reported as similar and immunomodulatory treatment was more frequent during recurrence.
AIDP accounted for 76.9% of first attacks and 84.6% of recurrent attacks.
Several paired comparisons are reported only as P > 0.05 with no confidence intervals or exact p-values; the SEA explicitly warns that this does not establish equivalence.
Table 1 contains 13 paired patient rows. Patient 12 has an interval printed as 6 without a unit; the SEA preserves that ambiguity.

source_integrity_notes: The supplied PDF prints PMID as xxxx; no external PMID was substituted.
Patient 12 between-attacks interval is printed as 6 without a unit in Table 1.
Two patients were excluded for comorbidities without further explanation in the source.
Treatment patterns differed substantially between attacks, limiting causal interpretation of disability comparisons.
